tools.name: get_centrifuge_specs
tools.description: Published specifications for an Alfa Laval disc stack or decanter centrifuge (or Dolphin DMPX/DMB module) remanufactured by Dolphin Centrifuge. Pass an exact model such as "MOPX 207" or a free-text query such as "diesel self-cleaning". Capacities always come with their fluid and conditions.

model.description: Model designation, alias or Dolphin module, e.g. "MOPX 207", "WHPX 405", "DMPX-028", "NX 418".

query.description: Free-text search when the exact model is unknown, e.g. "decanter 418" or "turbine oil".

offset.description: Result offset for a free-text search with more than 8 matches; use the returned page.nextOffset. Defaults to 0.

tools.name: list_centrifuge_models
tools.description: List the centrifuge models Dolphin publishes specs for, one line each, optionally filtered by type and by application/fluid keyword.

application.description: Fluid or application keyword, e.g. "diesel", "lube oil", "coolant", "wastewater".

tools.name: check_dolphin_stock
tools.description: Dated list of centrifuges (Alfa Laval, Sharples and ALDEC machines) from the written Dolphin Centrifuge inventory sheet (Warren, Michigan): model, maker, type, condition and availability, with counts split into ready-built units and units remanufactured to order after sale (a used unit remanufactured after an order, not a ready-built unit). The list date is the sheet date; availability is confirmed per quote. No prices or serial numbers.

model.description: Optional model or family filter, e.g. "MOPX 207" or "WHPX". Omit for the full list.

tools.name: size_centrifuge
tools.description: Relative centrifugal force (g-force) calculator using RCF = 1.118e-5 x r(cm) x RPM^2. Give any two of bowl_diameter_m, rpm, g_force and get the third plus basic separation guidance.

bowl_diameter_m.description: Bowl inside diameter in meters, e.g. 0.36.

rpm.description: Bowl speed in revolutions per minute.

tools.name: list_alfa_laval_published_documents
tools.description: List the Alfa Laval documents whose printed figures Dolphin Centrifuge offers, with document number, date and the machines each covers: the five MAB "S" technical data sheets (TD S93303E to S93307E, dated 1/73) and the MAPX / MOPX throughput table (MPCO 20-00-02). These are figures as printed by Alfa Laval in the named document, units as printed, not Dolphin measurements, guarantees or ratings; nothing is converted or calculated.

tools.name: get_alfa_laval_published_figures
tools.description: Return the figures Alfa Laval printed for one machine: sections, rows, columns and values with units as printed, plus the Alfa Laval document number and date. Covers MAB 204, 205, 206, 207 and 209 (also typed as MAB204, MAB-204 or MAB 204S), MAPX 204 and MOPX 205, 207, 209, 210 and 213. These are figures as printed by Alfa Laval in the named document, units as printed, not Dolphin measurements, guarantees or ratings; nothing is converted or calculated. A cell marked "not offered" could not be read with certainty and must not be filled in.

document.description: Optional Alfa Laval document number or id, e.g. "TD S93303E" or "MPCO 20-00-02". Omit for every document that covers the machine.

tools.name: get_machine_datasheet
tools.description: Return ONE whole Alfa Laval machine data sheet in a single call, with no paging: every figure Alfa Laval printed for it (capacity, bowl speed, motor power, solids space, weight, dimensions) with its condition, unit, source document, page and a ready-to-quote sentence, plus the documents and how many units of that model sit on Dolphin's inventory sheet (ready-built vs remanufactured to order). Model names written many ways work: "MOPX 207", "MOPX207", "mopx-207 TGT", "Alfa Laval MAB 204S". A bare family such as "MOPX" returns the list of models; a variant name returns the machine with each figure tagged by variant; no match returns the closest models, never an empty error. Figures are Alfa Laval's as printed, not Dolphin measurements or guarantees. This tool has no prices and no parts or drawings.

model.description: Machine model written any way, e.g. "MOPX 207", "MOPX207", "WHPX 510TGD" or "MAB 204S". A bare family such as "MOPX" returns the list of models.

tools.name: list_machines
tools.description: List the Alfa Laval machines that have a data sheet, one short line each (id, model, maker, type, variants, figure count, whether the model is on Dolphin's inventory sheet), optionally filtered by type ("disc stack", "self-cleaning", "manual-clean") and maker ("Alfa Laval"). Use it to find the right model, then call get_machine_datasheet. It carries no figures, no prices and no parts.

type.description: Optional machine type filter, e.g. "disc stack", "self-cleaning" or "manual-clean".

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send a quote or information request to Dolphin Centrifuge sales on behalf of the user. Only call with the user's explicit consent and their real name, company and email. Dolphin replies by email or phone within a few business days.

phone.description: Requester phone, if they want a call.

message.description: What the user needs: application details, solids, temperature, timeline.
